 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The world champions are on the road. Spain, fresh off lifting the World Cup, travel to Prague on Thursday, November 12 to face Czechia at the epet ARENA in Matchday 5 of the UEFA Nations League. Kick-off is 20:45 CET (19:45 UTC and 2:45 p.m. ET in the USA).
 La Roja have been perfect so far:  four games, four wins , 12 points, and the quarter-finals already wrapped up. All that's left to play for is keeping the record spotless and staying top of League A Group 3.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For  Czechia , it's a very different story. They're bottom with no points, two goals scored and ten conceded, so the only thing left is avoiding last place and a direct drop to League B.
 Spain won the first meeting 3-1 in Oviedo on October 3.
 One big miss for Spain:  Lamine Yamal  won't be in Prague. He's got a right  knee problem , picked up in Barça's 2-1 win over Atletico Madrid, and tests showed inflammation and fluid in the joint. Luis de la Fuente is playing it safe and expects him back before Sunday's game against England.
